title: The Ashwood/Vale sub-region has non-Euclidean loop connections (e.g. 'east' from The Hollow Path led to Wolf Scrape instead of toward the shrine/tower; 'west' from Wolf Scrape sometimes returned to Hollow Path). Required repeated free 'get your bearings' calls to find the actual path to the sunken shrine and old watchtower.
where: Ashwood exploration, around Twin Stones/Wolf Scrape/Hollow Path
